categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Adds a new fuzz harness in src/test/fuzz/musig.cpp and registers it in CMakeLists.txt with the Fuzzing label.
categories.rationale: Adds fuzz testing coverage to previously underexercised cryptographic signing and aggregation functions in src/musig. Reviewers note that 'the four signing functions in the module have no unit test today, only the wallet_musig.py functional test, so the harness covers ground that was empty', providing valuable validation for edge cases and malformed inputs.
